description: Aree percorse dal fuoco - Piano Strutturale del Comune di Bagno a Ripoli is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoserver.055055.it. Structural Plan of the Municipality of Bagno a Ripoli. A framework of knowledge. Constraints and protections. Areas covered by fire (ex L.R. 39/2000). The current Structural Plan was approved by Municipal Council Decision No 80 of 31 July 2023 and took effect with publication in BURT No 36 of 6 September 2023. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Areas covered by fire - Structural Plan of the Municipality of Bagno a Ripoli" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include opendata, c_a564, pianificazione, geodata, Comune di Bagno a Ripoli, vincoli. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
